description: Solidity describes smart contracts. A smart contract is code stored and run by a blockchain system. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Paste one contract into Remix and choose compiler 0.8.24 or later in the 0.8 series. Deploy only to Remix VM for practice. Call the function named in the lesson; shown results are return values.
versionNote: Examples use Solidity 0.8.24 or a compatible 0.8.x compiler.
whatYouWillLearn: Use a function input with Solidity
Add values in a loop with Solidity
Read a mapping value with Solidity
